title: doc-superpowers work-ledger index (ledger-index/1)
description: The derived, cached join that `doc-tools.sh ledger` verbs read (scripts/ledger/index.sh). Never committed. Keys appear in the order listed in `required`.

head.description: HEAD's commit id; null on an unborn branch, and for --rev (a rev build does not depend on HEAD).

base.description: The commit id config `base` names; null when it does not resolve. For --rev: the rev itself.

inputs_hash.description: The cache key: the file is index-<hex>.json.

rev.description: The commit id of --rev; null otherwise.

registry_findings.description: Structural `validate --registry` findings of the registry used (ownership checks excluded); the index uses the registry regardless.

contracts_error.description: Why the contracts adapter (config adapters.contracts) failed — the contracts are then the registry's alone, and every verb that shows relations exits 2; null when it ran or none is configured.

adoption.description: The adoption commit (Task 16c U11): the first commit on config base to add docs/ledger/config.json (git log --diff-filter=A, oldest first); null when the base has none, does not resolve, in a shallow clone whose boundary is where config.json first shows (it cannot be known), or for --staged.

contracts.description: Every contract (design §G): the registry's ledgers[].contracts[] and the contracts adapter's list, one per id, sorted by id. An id in both is one contract: the registry's ledger, defined_in and title win; the adapter's fill only what the registry leaves empty.

defined_in.description: Globs (scripts/ledger/glob.sh) of the files that define it.

path_contracts.description: For each file an item lists in paths that some contract's defined_in matches: those contract ids (the candidate rules, design §F.1).

class.description: Case-insensitive leading-word match of status against config `status`.

date.description: fields.date, else git's first-add date (renames chained), else the file's mtime (UTC) when uncommitted.

derived.description: Design §E.1, first match wins. Shown as: superseded → <detail> · won't fix · closed · shipped · merged · owed: <detail> · in review #<detail> · on branch <detail> · planned (<detail> = the plan) · spec'd (<detail> = the spec) · not started.

pr.description: The PR (config adapters.pr, through the remote cache) that claims the item, the one behind the status shown (highest number first): the merged one when the derived status is merged, else the open one, else the merged one; null when none does or no PR adapter is configured.

inflight.description: The in-flight branches that claim the item (config inflight.enabled; scripts/ledger/inflight.sh), by branch. Always [] in the cached index — a branch tip never rebuilds it: the read verbs (show, ls, find, view, publish) apply the in-flight overlay at query time (defs.jq lg_ifl_apply), which also sets derived to on branch / in review for an open item whose status ranked below.

host.description: The other machine's host id; null for this one's.

pr.description: The branch's open PR (config adapters.pr), or null.

neighbours.description: Confirmed relations (design §F.1): upstream — items whose changes meet this item's consumes, or that its relates names root-cause / depends-on; downstream — the reverse; siblings — a contract both change or both consume, or relates sibling (either side). Each {key, via}: the other item's key (its path when it has none) and the contract id or the relates kind; sorted by key, then via.

recheck_after.description: Re-check markers (design §F.2, computed): on an open item, the key of a re-check source that reached a terminal class on the base, or a contract it consumes that a base commit changed — after the item's last commit on the base. Not computed for --staged.

pre_adoption.description: From before the ledger was adopted (Task 16c U11; validate --all reports a missing resolution on such a terminal item as advisory): true when config base has no commit adding docs/ledger/config.json yet, or when the base holds the item's path and no commit after the adoption commit (built.adoption) touched it; false otherwise, when the base does not resolve, and when the adoption commit cannot be known (a shallow clone whose boundary is where config.json first shows: fails closed); null for --staged. A commit after the adoption commit: a descendant on the base's first-parent line, a merge counting with its changes against its first parent; a pure rename does not touch the moved file.

url.description: Hosted items only (config items.adapter; not in required): the adapter's url. A hosted item's path is the adapter's ref (gh#<n> for scripts/adapters/ledger-items-gh.sh); file items have no url.
